title: hydrolea zeylanica
intro: Hydrolea zeylanica, commonly known as the blue water-leaved hydrolea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydroleaceae. The health benefits of Hydrolea zeylanica include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hydrolea zeylanica include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
